name: Notify Me! Back in stock for WooCommerce
author: Notify Me!

sections.description:
Send automatic back-in-stock & restock alerts to the out-of-stock waiting list.

Don’t miss out on lost sales with back-in-stock alerts

Notify customers when items are back in stock and make an out-of-stock waitlist. Show the Notify Me! button on out-of-stock products and automatically send notifications when they get back in stock.

Why Notify Me?

– Send Automatic Stock Notifications.
– No need to install any plugin or service to send emails.
– Setup Notify Me Buttons in 1 Minute!
– Compatible with Almost Every Theme and Matched with any Theme Based on AI.
– Analyze Sales for Popular Out-of-Stock Inventory for Better Demand Forecasting.
– Dedicated 24/7 Customer Support via Live chat/Phone/E-mail.

Insightful Analytics Dashboard

Demand Forecasting: Predict future stock needs based on customer interest levels in specific products, helping prevent stockouts and overstock situations.

Customer Behavior Analysis: Understand which products are most sought after and which customers are most likely to purchase when notified, allowing for targeted marketing and promotional efforts.

Performance Metrics: Track the success rate of back-in-stock notifications in converting notifications to sales, providing a clear ROI for each product.

1-minute setup and Easy-to-use functions

Streamlined Installation: With clear, step-by-step guidance, you can have the app up and running in under a minute.

Intuitive Design: The interface is designed to be intuitive, making it easy for users of all skill levels to navigate and utilize the app’s full range of functions effectively.

Immediate Results: Start seeing the benefits of the app right away as it begins to track inventory and alert customers about product availability without delay.

24/7 Support for Your Peace of Mind

Immediate Assistance: Whether it’s late at night or early in the morning, our dedicated support team is always ready to help you resolve any issues you encounter.

Global Support: Our support team is accessible no matter where you are located, ensuring that time zones do not hinder your business operations.

Expert Problem Solving: Our support staff are well-trained experts, equipped with the knowledge to provide quick fixes and thorough solutions.

Real-Time Inventory Updates and Automatic Notifications

Instant Inventory Synchronization: The app continuously monitors your stock levels, updating them in real time as sales occur and stock is replenished. This ensures that your inventory records are always current, reducing the risk of overselling or stockouts.

Automated Customer Alerts: When a product that a customer is interested in becomes available, the system automatically sends a notification to the customer. This prompt communication helps capture sales opportunities by engaging customers at the moment products become available.

Compatible with Custom Themes

Flexible Design Adaptation: The app is designed to adapt to any theme, ensuring that it complements your site’s specific style and layout without requiring extensive customization.

No Coding Required: You won’t need to dive into code to make the app work with your theme; it’s built to automatically sync with your site’s unique elements.

Dedicated Theme Support: In case of any issues or specific requirements for custom theme integration, our dedicated support team is available 24/7 to provide personalized assistance. This ensures that the app not only matches your site aesthetically but also functions perfectly with your unique theme setup.

External Services

– Privacy Policy: https://notify-me.app/privacy
